summary: PRIMARY BUG (session persistence on refresh) is FIXED and verified. Backend pytest 16/16 pass. Frontend session flow 10/10 pass: admin & employee both stay authenticated after browser refresh (on /admin and /chat), token unchanged in localStorage, navigation through all 6 sidebar tabs (dashboard/knowledge/employees/settings/automations/feedback) never bounces to /login, logout clears wm_token, wrong credentials show error toast and do not set a token. Employee conversation history persists across refresh (8 conversations reloaded and clickable).
passed: GET /api/auth/me with valid admin token -> 200 correct profile
GET /api/auth/me with valid employee token -> 200 correct profile
UI: refresh on /admin -> stays on /admin (BUG FIX VERIFIED)
UI: localStorage.wm_token unchanged after refresh (bootstrap /auth/me succeeded without clearing token)
UI: nav clicks to dashboard/knowledge/employees/settings/automations/feedback do NOT redirect to /login
UI: refresh on admin subroute stays authenticated
UI: logout redirects to /login and removes wm_token
UI: refresh on /chat -> stays on /chat (BUG FIX VERIFIED)
UI: employee conversation history sidebar populated after refresh (8 convs), clicking loads messages
UI: wrong credentials show error toast, stay on /login, no token stored
UI: landing page loads, EN/AR language toggle flips document.dir to rtl
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext bootstrap retry-with-backoff correctly implemented: 3 attempts, only clears wm_token on real 401. Global 401 interceptor also present. This is exactly the right RCA fix.
Backend seed_technova() is properly idempotent (returns early if company slug 'technova' exists).

Minor: /api/auth/me with no Authorization header returns 403 (FastAPI HTTPBearer default) instead of 401. The AuthContext only clears the token on 401, so a bearer-less request would keep the token in place. Not a bug because the request interceptor always attaches the token from localStorage when it exists — just noting for completeness.

Minor observation (not the bug being fixed): AdminDashboard stats cards briefly showed 0/0/0 in one test run right after a language toggle; /api/stats API itself returns correct 4/4/8. Could be a UI mount race where /stats is fetched before axios interceptor picks up the token — worth a targeted look but does not affect the auth-persistence fix.

rca_of_bug_and_fix.root_cause: Previous AuthContext removed wm_token from localStorage on ANY error from GET /auth/me on mount. A transient 502/network blip during container warm-up on refresh caused a silent sign-out.
rca_of_bug_and_fix.fix_applied_by_main_agent: Bootstrap /auth/me now retries up to 3 times with exponential-ish backoff (700ms, 1400ms) and ONLY removes the token on an explicit 401 response. Added a global axios response interceptor that clears session and forces re-login on any 401 from any subsequent API call.
rca_of_bug_and_fix.verification: Reproduced original scenario by logging in and refreshing multiple times as both admin and employee — user stays authenticated, no bounce to /login, token stable in localStorage.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug is fixed. If retesting, use /app/backend/tests/test_auth_session.py for regression. For UI, exercise login -> refresh cycle multiple times as both admin (/admin) and employee (/chat). Only remove wm_token via logout or genuine 401.
